name: forge-release
description: GitHub Release drop-in for forge-native build artifacts. Creates and uploads releases via gh CLI, org-agnostic, idempotent with --clobber.

repo.description: org/repo or full URL for the target repository

artifact.description: local file path to upload as the release artifact

agent.squawk: forge-release: release lane active — building artifact and publishing to GitHub
agent.instructions: Run mise build first, then invoke releases/bin/forge-release with the built artifact path. Honor --clobber for idempotent re-releases. Mark cross-platform and Windows EV-sign as GA-boundary in the output.
